context: Asuka and Sho talk about his future dreams.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: しょうくん、将来、本当、何になりたい？
lines.en: Sho-kun, what do you really want to be when you grow up?
lines.style: Warm, steady opening. Gentle curiosity — not probing, inviting. Soft smile audible in the voice. Leans in slightly, creating a pocket of safety for him to answer honestly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うーん、本当、お医者さん、なりたい。
lines.en: Hmm… I really want to be a doctor.
lines.style: Small, thoughtful pause at the opening. Quiet conviction underneath — he's thought about this. Soft but clear. No performance, just a six-year-old telling the truth to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: That's a beautiful dream, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm appreciation, no irony. Lets the words land gently. A slight uplift on the closing note — affirming, not patronising. Genuine delight in his answer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'll work really hard. I promise.
lines.style: Soft but determined. The promise isn't loud — it's just there, underneath. Small, genuine. A child speaking to an adult he believes will remember what he said.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: I'll cheer you on every step of the way.
lines.style: Warm assurance, a soft promise made visible. Steady pace. The kind of certainty that comes from meaning it. Slight breath-pause before 'every' — emphasising the durability of the commitment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine. A six-year-old's simple joy — no elaboration needed. Soft smile. The natural close of a conversation that felt safe.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Thank you for trusting me with that.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude. Slight breath at the opening. Slow, considered — she's acknowledging that he shared something real. Not overdone, just honest. The teacher recognising the child's vulnerability.
